sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cloud Vulnerability Scanning and Penetration Testing SaaS

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English Common Law and French Civil Law with customary law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu-China Bilateral Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (entered into force 2008)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, in force 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 32 of 2016, as amended; Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Rules 2021; VFSC AML/CFT Directives and Guidance Notes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of valid passport page with photograph for each director, shareholder and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or solicitor in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for apostille member countries) or Consular Legalization by a Vanuatu diplomatic mission where no apostille arrangement exists

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter on bank letterhead confirming account conduct and source of wealth/funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank or licensed financial institution in the account-holder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Wet signature of bank official; if required, apostille on the notarized copy; otherwise consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified utility bill or residential address proof for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, municipal authority, or governmental records agency
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille by the competent authority in the issuing state; or consular legalization where apostille is not recognized

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All directors, shareholders, UBOs, and signatories must be screened pre-incorporation and thereafter updated monthly against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HMT sanctions, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, Australian DFAT sanctions list, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions notices. PEP status of the full beneficial ownership chain must be declared under penalty of law. Adverse media, negative integrity, and source-of-funds checks are mandatory. Any politically exposed person in the UBO chain triggers enhanced due diligence and senior management approval.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - National Company Registrar online portal (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal and administrative languages are English and French. An International Company may adopt a Latin-script name, and all registration documents must be in English or French. If a name is presented in a foreign script, a statutory English transliteration must be included and reserved through the VFSC portal. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Pty Ltd', or a recognized abbreviation such as 'Ltd', 'Corp', 'Inc'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the VFSC registry issues a written reasons notice. The applicant may file a written application for reconsideration to the VFSC Corporate Services Directorate within 14 days of the rejection, together with a signed certificate of justification and the prescribed appeal fee (approximately USD 85). A single extension of the name reservation may be requested before expiry by written submission and additional fee. If the rejection is upheld on reconsideration, a further administrative appeal may be made to the Registrar in accordance with the International Companies Act 1992, and ultimately to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A standalone virtual office is not acceptable for the statutory registered office. The International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu provided by a VFSC-licensed registered agent, normally in Port Vila or Luganville. Remote working arrangements outside Vanuatu are permissible for employees of a cloud SaaS business; no physical operating premises are required for an International Company engaged in cybersecurity SaaS as long as a compliant registered address exists.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search and availability certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory VFSC fee schedule under the International Companies Act 1992
Prescribed administrative fee for expedited name reservation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation filing fee for International Company

Prevailing market benchmark for a compliant Vanuatu International Company with AML/CFT infrastructure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT KYC and UBO piercing review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for initial KYC file assembly, risk scoring, and source-of-wealth review

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and consular legalization of bundles
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and apostille/consular authorities in document-issuing countries
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Estimated per-set cost based on notary tariff and apostille/consular fee schedules

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and negative-media sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance screening database provider / licensed agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-entity automated and manual screening benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for a low-risk International Company formation opinion; not a fixed statutory fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 32 of 1993, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2009 and 2011); incorporation and constitution under Part II (ss. 1–13), registered office and registered agent under Part III (ss. 17 and 32), directors and officers under ss. 39–46.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), IACI Building, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution) registered under section 7 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; Certificate of Incorporation sealed and issued by the VFSC Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; share capital may be denominated in any currency, shares may be issued at par or for such consideration as the Board determines, and no escrow or pre-deposit of capital into a Vanuatu bank account is required before incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscription agreement for 1,000 ordinary shares is approved, allotted, and entered in the Register of Members; (2) the registered office of the licensed agent at [Address], Port Vila, Vanuatu is adopted as the Company's legal seat; (3) [Name] is appointed sole director and [Name] company secretary, to hold office until replaced by the Board; (4) the director is authorized to open and operate bank accounts, appoint signatories, and conclude agreements for the cybersecurity SaaS business; (5) the common seal and minute book are adopted and all acts of the subscriber are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name reservation and pre-incorporation search with a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a licensed agent to conduct a name availability search with the VFSC Registry. Submit the proposed company name in English; the name must not be undesirable, prohibited, or identical or too closely resembling a name already registered in Vanuatu. Collect subscriber identity documents and execute a written engagement letter covering the entire formation package.
required_dossiers: Name availability confirmation or letter of reservation from VFSC corporate search
Passport copy and proof of residential address of the subscriber/beneficial owner
Signed engagement letter with the VFSC-licensed registered agent
Declaration confirming offshore status and non-carrying-on of local business in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the proposed name is refused on similarity grounds, obtain a letter of no-objection from the existing registrant or submit an alternative or numbered name for re-search; any VFSC requisition must be addressed in writing within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the Constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; execution before a Notary Public or by lawful attorney-in-fact
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Constitution in English including: company name, registered office clause in Vanuatu, authorized share capital, objects (unrestricted for an International Company), Board powers, share classes, and officer appointment machinery. The subscriber executes the Constitution; if execution occurs outside Vanuatu, signature must be notarized or made under a power of attorney acceptable to the VFSC.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution)
Subscriber statutory declaration and consent to incorporation
Power of attorney or notarial certificate where the subscriber signs remotely
Consent of each proposed director and officer to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries a drafting defect, prepare an amending or supplemental deed of adherence correcting the clause, re-execute it, and attach it to the original instrument before formal filing; no re-payment of the full fee is required for a purely clerical amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application and payment of government fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed Constitution together with the prescribed application form (Form 1) via the VFSC registry or the licensed agent's electronic portal. Pay the government incorporation fee of USD 250 (or equivalent in Vanuatu Vatu) by wire, bank transfer, or agent account. Obtain a stamped acknowledgment and unique application reference number from the Registry.
required_dossiers: Duly completed and signed Form 1 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
Executed original Constitution
Statutory fee payment receipt and VFSC acknowledgment
Certified identity and address verification of the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is requisitioned, cure the stated defect within the VFSC's 14-day response window, submit a supplementary declaration, and pay any applicable late fee; an adverse refusal may be appealed to the VFSC Appeals Panel, with re-filing permitted under a corrected package.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and opening of statutory records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation under seal, which evidences legal existence from the date of incorporation. The registered agent then prepares the share certificates, opens the statutory registers (Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Charges), and confirms the registered office address at Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the VFSC
Share certificate(s) executed in favor of the subscriber
Register of Members and Register of Directors
Registered agent consent letter and registered office confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a typographical or legal defect, file a statutory rectification request with the VFSC Registry; the Registry may issue an amended certificate or a Certificate of Good Standing reflecting the corrected particulars.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board meeting approval of governance and officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company, acting by physical meeting, telephone conference, or unanimous written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the statutory first Board meeting following incorporation. The Board adopts the pro-forma First Board Resolution approving the share allotment, adopting the registered office, appointing the director(s) and company secretary, and granting banking and execution authorities. Each appointee must sign a written consent to act, and signed minutes or a circular resolution are retained at the registered office.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution (pro forma) signed by all directors
Executed consent of directors and secretary to act
Minutes of the first Board meeting or unanimous written circular resolution
Banking mandate and list of authorized signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where an officer consent is missing or a procedural lapse is discovered, ratify the appointment by a further Board resolution and circulate the executed consent retroactively; retroactive ratification is permitted under the International Companies Act and the company's internal governance rules.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation operational onboarding (bank account, payment rails, and licensing clearance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bank of South Pacific (Vanuatu) Ltd or ANZ Vanuatu; VFSC Compliance and Licensing Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account in Vanuatu (or a licensed offshore bank) using the incorporation package. Configure the Stripe and wire transfer payment rails against the cleared account. Because the entity conducts a remote cybersecurity SaaS business with no physical footprint, no industrial, municipal, or environment licence is triggered; nevertheless, maintain annual VFSC renewal filings and the Certificate of Good Standing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and certified Constitution
Board resolution approving bank account opening and authorized signatories
Passport copies, references, and source-of-funds evidence for directors and beneficial owners (bank KYC)
Registered agent confirmation and current registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank challenges KYC documentation, supply corrected beneficial ownership declarations and source-of-funds evidence within the bank's SLA; if the account is declined, re-apply with a second licensed Vanuatu-based bank using the same formation package without additional regulatory filing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board applies to ISIC 6201 (cloud vulnerability scanning and penetration testing SaaS). The VFSC remains the sole regulator for ongoing corporate compliance; the Port Vila Municipal Council would require only a municipal business licence if a physical office is later opened in Vanuatu.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — Vanuatu maintains a zero-licence regime for remote cybersecurity SaaS services; the only certification to keep current is the VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and the annual renewal receipt.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Port Vila, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from EIA registration: a pure digital software and remote penetration-testing service has no physical installations, no land disturbance, no water discharge and no air emissions. An EIA would only become necessary if the company later constructs a data centre, telecommunications infrastructure, or permanent office above the Schedule thresholds of the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or stack-emission limits apply to a SaaS operation without physical plant. Prudent compliance requires DEPC solid-waste guidance for WEEE/e-waste (responsible recycling of hardware) under the Waste Management Act No. 25 of 2016, and, if emergency diesel generators are used, adherence to ambient air quality benchmarks for diesel exhaust particulate and NOx emissions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not statutorily required for a remote workforce. Should the Company establish a physical Port Vila office, it must obtain an occupancy clearance comprising: a fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services, a building occupancy and structural load inspection certificate from the Port Vila Municipal Council, and an employer workplace health-and-safety return under the Employment Act [Cap. 160]; homeworkers and remote contractors require no such clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Commission (VRCC), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue; official portal: www.customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) formed under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes; therefore no TIN or VAT ID procurement is required for IC formation. The sole compulsory registration is with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent, who files the Memorandum and Articles of Incorporation and pays the annual government fee (approx. VT 35,000–42,000). If the IC were to conduct prohibited domestic business (not permitted), it would first be re-registered as a local company, obtain a TIN and VAT ID from VRCC, and forfeit IC tax-exempt status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in Vanuatu; the IC enjoys automatic zero-tax status under s.7 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. No hybrid mismatch election is available or necessary because Vanuatu imposes no income tax at any level. The Articles of Incorporation may elect restricted or unrestricted IC scope, but no further tax status election is recognized.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 taxable turnover in any consecutive 12-month period (VAT Act No. 12 of 1998, s.4)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory real-time e-invoicing, digital fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping regime exists in Vanuatu as of the current law. The VRCC does not require certified fiscal printers, e-invoice clearance, or blockchain stamps. Ordinary commercial invoices are sufficient; the IC is fully outside the VAT filing net.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services supplied for the direct use and benefit of a person outside Vanuatu are zero-rated under Schedule 1 of the VAT Act 1998. The cybersecurity SaaS model (cloud vulnerability scanning and penetration testing) qualifies as an offshore service export where the customer receives and consumes the service outside Vanuatu; contractual place-of-consumption clauses and IP-geolocation evidence are recommended. In practice, the IC never registers for VAT because s.7 of the International Companies Act and s.6 of the VAT Act exclude ICs from taxable activity; zero-rating applies automatically without a VAT return filing obligation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No Customs Export Declaration applies to digital SaaS exports
Commercial invoice describing the service, customer jurisdiction, and SaaS licensing territory
Signed SaaS subscription agreement evidencing place of consumption outside Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or SWIFT/wire transfer advice evidencing payment from the foreign customer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, so no income-tax clawback exists. For VAT fraud, the VAT Act imposes penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded plus interest, with potential criminal prosecution by VRCC. An IC that breaches the statutory prohibition on conducting domestic business may be struck off by the VFSC, and the offending revenue would be retrospectively exposed to the full 12.5% VAT. Since the IC regime bars Vanuatu-sourced revenue, genuine offshore SaaS receipts carry negligible audit exposure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the statutory monetary authority, prudential banking supervisor, and custodian of the Vatu (VUV), with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) functioning as the parallel licensing and registration authority for international companies and non-bank financial service providers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu is an IMF Article VIII economy, meaning the Vatu is convertible for current international transactions and there is no exchange-control licensing requirement for bona fide trade, investment, or profit remittance activity. In practical terms, capital account movements also proceed without RBV pre-approval for a 100% foreign-owned International Company; the effective constraints arise from the shallow domestic interbank market, dependence on correspondent banking in AUD, USD, and EUR, and FATF-sensitive verification of the underlying commercial substance. The combination of zero domestic income tax, zero dividend withholding, and no thin-capitalisation restriction creates a structurally clear lane for SaaS exports, foreign equity injections, and repatriation of profits, subject only to documentary evidence satisfying the tier-1 bank's correspondent risk filters.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory domiciling of export receipts, and no required conversion ratio for foreign-currency export proceeds. A cybersecurity SaaS exporter may retain USD, AUD, or EUR in offshore or domestic multi-currency accounts, and may freely convert to VUV through licensed FX dealers without RBV approval. The only compliance obligation is documentary: the KYC/AML file must evidence the lawful origin of subscription revenue, the client relationship, and the commercial consistency of the ISIC 6201 software-security scope.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility rating. Vanuatu has no dedicated electronic-money-institution (EMI) or neobank licensing class under the Banking Act; any digital wallet or EMI operation requires a full banking licence or a ministerial exemption, with a physical head office in Port Vila, resident senior management, and the RBV's prudential capital floor. Offshore virtual EMIs such as Wise, Revolut, or Stripe Treasury do not support Vanuatu-domiciled entities as direct settlement rails and cannot independently clear VUV. A locally licensed bank can act as a banking-as-a-service sponsor, but this is contractual and does not alter the underlying licensing analysis. Consequently, the IC should treat the official domestic banks as the primary treasury anchor and any fintech EMI as a non-authoritative auxiliary channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Neither the RBV prudential codes nor the AML/CFT framework imposes a literal statutory rule that all directors must appear in a Vanuatu branch; however, the risk-based interpretation applied by every tier-1 bank makes a physical or bank-sanctioned remote KYC interview operationally mandatory. The acceptable routes are: (i) an in-person board presentation in Port Vila; (ii) a bank-approved video KYC session with live identity verification, supported by a notarised or apostilled certificate of incumbency and a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; or (iii) a written introduction and corporate attestation by a recognised Vanuatu registered agent, followed by a telephone interview of each 10% or greater beneficial owner. Without one of these routes, unattended remote opening for a zero-tax International Company is uniformly declined.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Zero-tax exempt International Company presenting as a potential shell or letter-box structure with no evident physical or operational substance in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC International Company registration certificate and up-to-date annual returns; registered-agent agreement; board minutes evidencing real strategic oversight; virtual-office or sub-lease agreement in Vanuatu; audited or accountant-reviewed financial statements for the first two operating years; documented paid-in capital movement traceable from the investor's bank; and a briefing note reconciling the Saudi-style 'Tax_Exempt_Zone' classification with the entity's factual commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound concentration followed by immediate onward payments, indicating possible money movement rather than genuine SaaS trade
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A 12-month source-of-funds trail covering the beneficial owners' primary banking relationship; full invoice set and signed subscription or penetration-testing engagement letters; treasury policy minutes approving the clearing of payments to subprocessors and cloud infrastructure providers; an SWIFT MT103 chain report for representative receipts; and a CFO or auditor letter explaining the SaaS annual prepayment model and the escrow treatment of implementation fees.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cyber-security services with offensive-testing features generating an elevated dual-use and terrorism-financing risk narrative
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II attestations; CREST or equivalent penetration-testing certification for the responsible technical team; contractual scoping documents identifying the client's owned asset boundaries; end-user and export-control declarations for each licensed instance of the vulnerability scanner; an operational vulnerability-disclosure policy; and internal governance records showing rejection or escalation of clients in prohibited or sanctions-listed jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border revenues originating from high-risk jurisdictions, virtual-asset service providers, or opaque third-party payment intermediaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial-owner declarations authenticated by passport copies and notarised forms; UN, OFAC, EU, and UK sanctions screening reports prepared no earlier than the onboarding week; a universal exclusion of crypto-denominated settlement stated in the treasury policy; a whitelist of permitted payment gateways; and transactional corroboration in the form of MT103 messages referencing the IC's exact corporate name and bank identifier.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant routing is a direct SWIFT MT103 wire from the investor's bank to the IC's corporate account at the tier-1 Vanuatu bank, with the remittance field clearly reading 'VU_IC equity subscription' and referencing the VFSC-certified company name. The onboarding file already lodged at the bank must contain the underlying equity subscription agreement, the board resolution authorising the share issue, the updated shareholders' register, and a source-of-funds statement identifying the investor and the final beneficial owner. Vanuatu requires no RBV exchange-control permit and no VFSC approval for inward investment; the bank's internal policy, however, requires the MT103 message to be consistent with the KYC file so that the correspondent settlement bank cannot dispute the transaction. If the injection is structured as an intercompany loan, the borrower should additionally file a signed loan agreement with interest terms, a repayment schedule, and an asset-liability explanation so the bank does not retrospectively reclassify the credit as equity for reporting purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For a cybersecurity SaaS exporter, the operative clearing rails are: (1) SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers for periodic licence and subscription payments; (2) SWIFT MT202 COV for bank-to-bank cover where the beneficiary is cleared through a correspondents; (3) commercial letters of credit and standby credits for enterprise security-infrastructure contracts requiring documentary settlement; (4) Visa and Mastercard acquiring through a local or Australian licensed gateway for card-present SaaS sales; and (5) negotiated payment-facilitator and white-label PSP arrangements, since Stripe and comparable global rails are not natively activated for Vanuatu-domiciled entities. For treasury efficiency, the IC should maintain a USD operational account for client billing and a VUV account for local statutory spend, with an approved daily sweep instruction executed by the relationship manager under a board-approved liquidity policy.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OTC forward contracts with a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank, permitted only where a documented USD or AUD exposure (SaaS invoices or cloud infrastructure costs) gives rise to an underlying treasury risk.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in VUV against USD, AUD, or EUR, legally permissible for Vanuatu ICs because the country imposes no exchange-control prohibition on hedging; the exposure evidence must be retained in the hedge file.

Cross-currency swaps (VUV against USD, AUD, or EUR) executed under an ISDA Master Agreement with a regulated offshore bank, limited to the notional amount of intercompany debt or forward trade commitments and approved by the IC board.
FX options and zero-premium collars written by OECD-regulated banks on a stand-alone commercial-risk basis, excluding leveraged or speculative structures that lack an identified underlying exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return (RIC Annual Declaration) filed by the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based filing: due within one calendar month following the annual anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing exposes the company and each defaulting officer to offence-level fines of up to VUV 1,000,000; continued non-filing beyond the statutory cure period enables the Registrar to publish a strike-off notice and dissolve the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Duty payment on authorized capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Revenue Collection Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on the incorporation anniversary each year; ordinarily remitted together with the Annual Return by the Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid duty accrues as a continuing debt; failure to remit within the prescribed renewal period permits the Registrar to strike the International Company off the Register after Gazette notice without further demand

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Beneficial Ownership Compliance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due on the incorporation anniversary; interim update required within 30 days of any share transfer, allotment, or change in controlling ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm or update beneficial ownership particulars constitutes an offence carrying monetary penalties against the company, each defaulting officer, and the Registered Agent; material omissions may trigger AML/CFT regulatory review

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Declaration (agent engagement and statutory register location statement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Corporate Compliance Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the Annual Return on the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delinquency subjects the Registered Agent to regulatory suspension; if the agent resigns and no replacement agent is appointed within the statutory period, the company is liable to administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a standard Vanuatu International Company conducting non-licensed business; mandatory independent audit is confined to license-holders regulated by VFSC (banking, insurance, securities, and fiduciary licensees). A pure cybersecurity SaaS exporter with no VFSC license therefore has no audit trigger under ordinary circumstances.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The International Companies Act requires the company to maintain records sufficient to present a true and fair view of its financial position and to explain material transactions; IFRS is the applicable recognized framework for any voluntary audit, transfer-pricing documentation, or third-party financial reporting, as no local GAAP filing obligation exists for International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at the registered agent's office identifying every individual with direct or indirect ownership, control, or right to profits exceeding 25%. The Registered Agent is obliged to verify beneficial ownership at onboarding and to deliver an annual confirmation to the VFSC; any share transfer, issuance, or dilution event occurring during the preceding year must be reflected and reported within the statutory update window

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not compulsory; voluntary certified audit for SaaS security or investor diligence typically USD 4,000 - USD 8,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (no corporate income tax is levied in Vanuatu; International Companies are statutorily exempt under the International Companies Act, Cap. 222)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent statutory income tax exemption for International Companies: 0% corporate income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% dividend distribution tax, and no payroll tax or social-security levy. The only recurring fiscal costs are the VFSC government registration/filing fee and the licensed registered agent fee. Cross-border SaaS subscription and penetration-testing revenue is additionally zero-rated for VAT. No preferential deduction or tax holiday schedule exists because the effective statutory rate is already zero.
